sceneConcept: A calm twenty-seven-year-old Chinese encrypted-channel host stands alone against a transparent background in her broadcast identity. Asymmetrical short black hair frames one visible grey eye, while a rigid completely plain matte-white theatrical half mask covers only her left temple, left eye and left cheek; her nose tip, mouth and jaw remain fully uncovered. She wears a dark-grey utility recording jacket over a black turtleneck, cargo trousers, ankle boots, unlit headphones around her neck and black fingerless gloves. Facing a compact studio microphone with a round pop filter on a short stand, she rests one hand on its adjustment collar and prepares to speak with a closed mouth. Soft even frontal studio light keeps every surface matte and controlled. Visual refresh: a half mask, audio harness and asymmetrical underground broadcast streetwear.
naturalLanguageDetail: A calm twenty-seven-year-old Chinese encrypted-channel host with asymmetrical short black hair wears a rigid plain matte-white theatrical half mask covering only her left temple, eye and cheek while her mouth and jaw remain uncovered, resting one fingerless-gloved hand on a compact studio microphone stand under soft even frontal studio light; a half mask, audio harness and asymmetrical underground broadcast streetwear.
